text:
sara: Heads-up — pool34 showing sustained uptick in correctable ECC and page retirement events on cards 4, 7, and 12 over the last 12h. See: https://console.redwood/infra/pool34/metrics :page_facing_up:
liam: which metric? row_remap or page_retire count? any Xid spikes?
raj: row_remap count + page_retire both trending. quick excerpt from nvml logs:
```
CARD12: ECC_CORRECTABLE: 128 last 6h
CARD12: PAGE_RETIRE: 9 last 6h
Xid 61/79 occasional
```
kevin: hmm, pattern looks like slow mem degradation rather than transient noise. card12 is the worst. capacity-wise usw1 pools are ~85% used so draining will be tight.
monitor-bot: alert triggered: pool34-card12 page_retire_rate >= 5/hr for 3h. ticket INC-4521 created.
ops-bot: INC-4521: created RMA/replace workflow and attached nvml logs. Owner: @kevin
sara: plan proposal: 1) schedule a rolling drain of card12 tomorrow 02:00 UTC during low traffic 2) failover live jobs to pool36 burst capacity 3) open vendor support RMA if errors persist after drain
liam: +1 for scheduled drain. can we add temporary tighter alerting: page_retire >= 3 in 30m -> paging oncall?
raj: added alert rule in monitoring: `page_retire_rate{pool="pool34",card="12"} > 3` for 15m -> pager.
kevin: I'll check allocation windows and pre-warm pool36 with prioritized batching to avoid OOM. also will run memtest overnight on card12 once drained.
sara: assign follow-ups: @kevin handle drain & pre-warm, @raj update dashboards & alerts, @liam coordinate runtimes to reduce critical jobs during drain. ops-bot will post RMA updates in this thread.
kevin: noted, will post status. if vendor confirms row-remap escalation, request expedited swap. :thumbsup:
monitor-bot: monitor snapshot: 2026-03-17 22:00 UTC — card12 correctable ECC rate = 21/hr, page_retire=12 last 6h.
sara: thanks. keep short updates here. if any Xid 31 or persistent hw faults appear, escalate to SEV.
kevin: copying logs to /mnt/ops/INC-4521/card12_logs.tar.gz and sharing with vendor.
liam: good. marking thread for follow-up after drain. :white_check_mark:
